title: Authorization inconsistency across identities/protocols
impact: An access-control inconsistency (anonymous/unauth path, or differing authorization across protocols/identities) may expose a privilege boundary that no single detector flags.
remediation: Require authentication; align authorization across protocols/roles; re-test the inconsistent path.
description: An authorization/authentication inconsistency was observed. No matching known vulnerability identified by the local knowledge base; manual research and validation required.
